title: KnowDemo: Knowledge-Guided Robot Demonstration Generation from Human Videos
abstract: arXiv:2609.21229v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Learning robot manipulation policies typically requires substantial demonstration data, which are costly to collect on real robots. Recent methods generate robot demonstrations from human videos by adapting recovered motion and validating the resulting trajectories in simulation. However, methods centered on motion-reference adaptation can limit behavioral diversity by retaining the demonstrated contact strategies and subtask orders, while insufficient understanding of task requirements and scene relations can reduce demonstration generation efficiency by generating invalid candidates. To address these limitations, we propose KnowDemo, a framework that uses structured manipulation knowledge from human videos to generate diverse robot demonstrations for a target workspace. translated_title: KnowDemo：知识引导的从人类视频生成机器人演示
translated_abstract: 学习机器人操作策略通常需要大量的演示数据，而在真实机器人上收集这些数据成本高昂。最近的方法通过适配恢复的运动并在仿真中验证所得轨迹，从人类视频中生成机器人演示。然而，以运动参考适配为中心的方法会保留演示中的接触策略和子任务顺序，从而限制了行为多样性；而对任务需求和场景关系理解不足，则会因生成无效候选而降低演示生成的效率。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了KnowDemo，这是一个利用从人类视频中提取的结构化操作知识，为目标工作空间生成多样化机器人演示的框架。为了将任务需求与演示特定的选择区分开来，我们开发了一个基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的知识提取与推理模块……
tldr: KnowDemo提出利用视觉语言模型从人类视频中提取结构化操作知识，以生成行为多样且高效的机器人演示，克服了现有方法行为多样性受限和生成效率低下的问题。
en_tdlr: KnowDemo leverages a vision-language model to extract structured manipulation knowledge from human videos, generating diverse and efficient robot demonstrations that overcome the limited behavioral diversity and low generation efficiency of existing methods.
